violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - Observed: kefir whole milk (56f) has been stored in 3-door prep cooler (#4) for 7 hours. Sproud milk (46f) was stored in 3-door prep cooler (#4) for 4 hours. Kale (43f) was stored in walk-in cooler for more than 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - Corrective actions: CFM discarded the abovementioned food items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - Observed: kale (43f) was prepared on 10/6/2026 and stored in walk-in cooler for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - Corrective actions: CFM discarded the kale.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. - Observed: bread in carton boxes were stored on floor in walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. - Corrective actions: EHS prompted CFM to relocate the bread before an additional storage rack is provided.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed: no heat sensitive test strip (thermolabel) or plate simulating dishwasher tester available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. - Corrective actions: please obtain thermolabels or a plate simulating dishwasher tester within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - Observed: a chemical mixing dispenser is connected down stream from the mop sink equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker through an unapproved splitter.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - Corrective actions: EHS shared information of approved splitter with CFM. The facility will need to install an approved splitter on the mop sink within 3 calendar days.
